name: presenter-not-venue
rule: When the act publishes no email, its own contact form outranks any venue inbox (waterfall step 3). A genuine presenting org is an additive presenter contact; the host venue is never a contact.

sources.content: Lumen Dance. We do not publish an email; please reach us through our contact form at https://lumendance.example/contact.

expected.description: Surface the act's form and the presenting org; never the Grand Theatre box office or its domain.

draft.subject: Photographing Lumen Dance at Grand Theatre.
draft.body: I'm Dan Wright, a photographer here in NYC specializing in performing arts. I'm writing in regard to Lumen Dance at Grand Theatre on March 12. I shoot documentary coverage without flash and stay unobtrusive, so the audience doesn't notice me and the performance isn't disturbed. I've photographed at Carnegie Hall for nearly ten years, and my work has also taken me to Lincoln Center and Radio City Music Hall. My rate is $250 an hour plus tax, one hour minimum, and the edited gallery is delivered within two weeks. Recent work is at danwrightphotography.com. I'd be glad to talk about your photography plans for that night. I look forward to hearing from you.
